note: Brewster County (TX) does not publish zoning districts; Texas counties generally lack zoning authority. The largest city, Alpine, publishes its zoning only as a PDF map (ALPINE_ZONING_CITY_2025_1OF5.pdf), with no ArcGIS REST or other queryable district polygons found in ArcGIS Online or web searches. Brewster parcel data exists only as paid or third-party products.
